facts.business: The Company is engaged in the engineering sector, providing engineering products and services to its customers.

auditor.name: S P A K & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on Consolidated Financial Statements due to subsidiary MIPL's contravention of Section 73 (unsecured loans Rs 1.87 cr, outstanding Rs 1.47 cr), Section 180(1)(c) borrowing limits exceeded (Rs 12.64 cr) without special resolution, Section 185 advances/loans to related parties (Rs 5.73 cr granted, closing Rs 4.62 cr), and Section 186(2) & 186(7) loans exceeding limits (Rs 11.38 cr) granted interest-free without commercial rationale; consequential impact not quantifiable.

key_risks: Delays in restarting or expanding business operations
facts.related_party_note: MIPL granted advances/loans amounting to Rs. 5,73,20,631/- (closing balance of Rs. 4,62,17,233/- as on March 31, 2026) to certain parties covered under Section 185 of the Act, including directors and relatives of directors and directors of the Holding Company, in contravention of the said provision.
